# Mantra Sports India

> Mantra Sports India (www.mantrasports.co.in) is the Indian online store for Mantra Sports cricket equipment. Customers can buy online with secure Razorpay checkout (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets) and orders ship across India. Clubs, academies, schools and retailers can also request wholesale and B2B quotes. Operated by Mantra Sports International, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh (GSTIN 09IVBPS2213F1ZM).

## What we sell
- English willow cricket bats from Players’ Grade to Grade III: Magnitude, Raptor and Cobra ranges
- Protective gear: batting gloves, wicket-keeping gloves, leg guards, thigh guards, helmets
- Leather cricket balls (red, white, pink, yellow)
- Performance sportswear for teams
- Accessories: grips, kit bags, stumps, training gear
